title: Checkpoints
statementMd:
Vasya takes part in the orienteering competition. There are $*n*$ checkpoints located along the line at coordinates $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$. Vasya starts at the point with coordinate $*a*$. His goal is to visit at least $*n* - 1$ checkpoint in order to finish the competition. Participant are allowed to visit checkpoints in arbitrary order.

Vasya wants to pick such checkpoints and the order of visiting them that the total distance travelled is minimized. He asks you to calculate this minimum possible value.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*a*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $- 1 000 000 ≤ *a* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the number of checkpoints and Vasya's starting position respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ ($- 1 000 000 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$) — coordinates of the checkpoints.

## Output

Print one integer — the minimum distance Vasya has to travel in order to visit at least $*n* - 1$ checkpoint.

## Note

In the first sample Vasya has to visit at least two checkpoints. The optimal way to achieve this is the walk to the third checkpoints (distance is $12 - 10 = 2$) and then proceed to the second one (distance is $12 - 7 = 5$). The total distance is equal to $2 + 5 = 7$.

In the second sample it's enough to visit only one checkpoint so Vasya should just walk to the point $- 10$.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 参加定向越野比赛。在一条直线上，坐标为 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ 的位置上分布着 $*n*$ 个检查点。Vasya 从坐标为 $*a*$ 的点出发。他的目标是至少经过 $*n* - 1$ 个检查点，以完成比赛。参赛者可以按照任意顺序经过检查点。

Vasya 希望选择要经过的检查点及其访问顺序，使得行走的总距离最小。请你计算这个最小可能值。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*a*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$- 1 000 000 ≤ *a* ≤ 1 000 000$）——检查点的数量以及 Vasya 的起点坐标。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$- 1 000 000 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 1 000 000$）——各个检查点的坐标。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Vasya 为了经过至少 $*n* - 1$ 个检查点所需要行走的最小距离。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vasya 至少需要经过两个检查点。达到目标的最优方案是先走到第三个检查点（距离为 $12 - 10 = 2$），然后继续走到第二个检查点（距离为 $12 - 7 = 5$）。总距离为 $2 + 5 = 7$。

在第二个样例中，只经过一个检查点就足够了，因此 Vasya 只需走到点 $- 10$。
